candidate.name: gaussian_bias_scale_weighted_mean
candidate.identification: normal_median and robust_scale use source calibration normal parents only; Gaussian weights use crop geometry only
candidate.parameter_selection: No target normal, defect score, annotation, or metric selects sigma_scale, center, scale, or component inclusion.

component_ablations.gaussian_bias_equal_mean: Gaussian geometry plus normal-coordinate bias subtraction
component_ablations.gaussian_scale_weighted_mean: Gaussian geometry times inverse normal-coordinate robust variance without bias subtraction

development_gate.interpretation: The full candidate alone determines continuation. Failure stops this geometry-times-calibration formulation; component ablations may explain failure but may not select a replacement.

confirmation.support_condition: Positive six-roll macro Pixel AP against both frozen PCAF and Gaussian, with every fold reported and no more than one aggregate additional target-normal false positive relative to PCAF.

provenance.motivation: The completed K0 audit found fixed center windows stronger than PCAF in roll-macro Pixel AP, motivating a product-of-reliabilities estimator rather than post-result window tuning.
